Welcome to Vet1! 🩺🐾 
Our channel offers FREE WEBINARS, Tips, Tricks, Advice and How-To Videos focusing on everything veterinary education. We are paying particular attention to the easy and stress free use of vet specific equipment, products and consumables.

We have collaborated with @tessthevetnurse to bring you fun, exciting and relatable content that is easy to learn and digest. 

To be the first to know about our new release downloadable guides specifically made for Veterinarians and Veterinary Nurses, make sure to follow us on socials:
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/vet1_au/
Tiktok - https://www.tiktok.com/@vet1_
Downloadable Guides - https://vet1.com.au/veterinary-guides/ to download 

Check out our website for all your equipment and consumables: https://vet1.com.au/

#vet1au #veterinaryequipment #veterinarysupplier #vet1 #veterinaryconsumables #vet #vetmed #veterinarydentistry #floline #veterinarydental
